text:
maya: Quick heads-up — scheduling a prelaunch media dry run for next Tue 10:00am PT / 6:00pm BST. Need an APAC-friendly slot too. Who can own the runbook + final kit link?

oliver: I can own the runbook. can someone confirm the press kit URL and CEO soundbites?

lia: Press kit is almost final — put the latest in Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/presskit — still waiting on legal for one line.

tony: I can do APAC-friendly slot. propose Wed 8:30am SGT as fallback. works for brief 30m Q&A.

maya: @tony SG slot sounds good. @oliver please include both times in the invite and mark the SGT option as "optional APAC attendance".

pressbot: Reminder: calendar slot provisional created: Prelaunch media dry run — Tue 10:00 PT + Wed 08:30 SGT (optional). RSVP link: https://cal.redwood.com/meeting/12345 :spiral_calendar:

oliver: draft runbook checklist (short):
```
- 5m overview + key metric highlights
- 10m CEO soundbite + product demo (screen share)
- 10m analyst Q&A
- 5m logistics + followups (press kit link + contacts)
```

eva: Legal flagged two lines in the soundbite that need rewording. I'll coordinate a quick rewrite and get sign-off by EOD Fri.

maya: thanks @eva. for the quote, prefer a short "one-liner" we can push to press — less likely to trigger redlines.

lia: Also need a single point of contact for fact-check passes. reporters often ask for API throughput numbers and our latency baseline. who owns that?

tony: @eng-prod (not in this channel) will provide official numbers. oliver, can you request the 99th percentile latency and cost per token stat?

oliver: on it. i'll ping eng-prod and add the snippet to the runbook as the "fact-pass attachment".

maya: Perfect. final ask — if a reporter requests an embargo exception, route to me + lia immediately. we'll triage and loop in legal. Keep public comms standard: no early quotes until sign-off. :white_check_mark:
